title: EUPE implementation and EUPE-ViT-S model resource linked
summary: On 2026-03-31, the EUPE development line recorded links to the facebookresearch/eupe repository and the facebook/EUPE-ViT-S Hugging Face resource. This is treated as a material availability milestone because it identifies both an implementation location and a named model resource. The supplied evidence does not establish a release version, capabilities, or artifact status beyond those dated links.
